summary: City workers speak with affection for their jobs while pressing for pay, conditions and leave, and an official answers with a trade-off.
realLife: Dozens of city workers spoke before a closed session before a planned strike; the mayor replied that larger raises could mean service cuts and layoffs and decisions are made by majority vote.
sources: ABC7 News, San Jose city workers strike and council public comment: https://abc7news.com/post/san-jose-city-workers-strike-of-labor-unions-latest/13620380/
inGame: a protest or strike with officials at the edge; the job record (position, employer); needs: unions as organizations
